newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Falcon EPS view trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Falcon EPS view trimmed.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it lowered its EPS estimates on Falcon Products Inc to $0.27 from $0.30 for the Q4 and to $0.86 from $0.93 for full-year FY96.
--It also reduced its 1997 estimate by $0.05 to $1.05 per share.

--In a report, EVEREN said the earnings reductions are based on a Q3 shortfall as well as a lower revenue growth assumption and lower gross margins due to the lower fixed cost absorption particularly in the company's new West Coast facility.
